definitions.explanation: The quality of being relative rather than absolute — that is, existing or having value only in relation to something else. Used both as a general philosophical concept and as a physics term referring to Einstein's theory of relativity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{価値観|かちかん}→価値観：10431_kachikan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{相対性|そうたいせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{認|みと}める→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: It's important to recognize the relativity of values.

examples.japanese: アインシュタイン⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{相対性|そうたいせい}{理論|りろん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{物理学|ぶつりがく}→物理学：09631_butsurigaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{変|か}えた→変える：01089_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: Einstein's theory of relativity greatly changed physics.

examples.japanese: ⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{相対性|そうたいせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{理解|りかい}しなければ→理解する：06059_rikaisuru⟧、⟦{異|こと}なる→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧⟦{価値観|かちかん}→価値観：10431_kachikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{入|い}れる→受け入れる：05755_ukeireru⟧こと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: Without understanding cultural relativity, it is difficult to accept different values.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{相対|そうたい}→相対：13713_soutai⟧ (relative, mutual) and ⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧ (nature, quality). The ⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧ suffix transforms an adjective or noun into an abstract quality, similar to English "-ity" or "-ness."

Most famously associated with Einstein's {相対性|そうたいせい}{理論|りろん} (theory of relativity), but the word is also widely used in philosophy, cultural studies, and everyday discussion to express the idea that things can only be understood in relation to other things.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {相対性|そうたいせい}{理論|りろん}: theory of relativity
- ⟦{一般|いっぱん}→一般：01737_ippan⟧{相対性|そうたいせい}{理論|りろん}: general theory of relativity
- ⟦{特殊|とくしゅ}→特殊：04566_tokushu⟧{相対性|そうたいせい}{理論|りろん}: special theory of relativity
- ⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{相対性|そうたいせい}: cultural relativity
- ⟦{価値|かち}→価値：00131_kachi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{相対性|そうたいせい}: relativity of values

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{相対的|そうたいてき}→相対的：05850_soutaiteki⟧: relative (adjective) — the adjectival form used to describe something as relative rather than absolute
- {絶対性|ぜったいせい}: absoluteness — the opposite concept, the quality of being absolute
- ⟦{相対|そうたい}→相対：13713_soutai⟧: relative; facing each other — the base form without the abstract-quality suffix
